title: Smoky Thai Stew
description: A hearty and aromatic Thai stew made with smoky flavors and earthy undertones. Serve over steamed rice for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: smoky sauce
ingredients.notes: make with smoked chili peppers and soy sauce

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add galangal and cook until fragrant.
Add fernbrake and cook until it starts to soften.
Add stew, smoky sauce, and kaffir lime leaves.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with earthly spices to taste.
Serve over steamed rice and garnish with chopped kaffir lime leaves.
